name: Time-Series Momentum Cross-Asset ETF (Volatility Scaled)
stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard 2.0x ATR protective stop and monthly volatility-target rebalance
rule_description: Go long liquid ETFs with positive 12-month trailing excess return and reduce to T-Bill/cash or short defensive hedge when trailing return turns negative; position sized inversely to realized volatility with a hard 2.0x ATR protective stop, zero martingale, zero grid.
raw_text: Public academic literature summary (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen). Universe: broad liquid ETFs (SPY, TLT, GLD) with zero overnight CFD swap. Signal: sign of trailing 12-month return evaluated on D1/monthly rebalance. Risk control: volatility scaling with explicit hard 2.0x ATR protective stop; strictly avoids grid and never uses martingale. Sample vendor blog commentary mentions strong OOS2 rally during 2025 and 2026 bull markets.
